More than just pickleball

ELEVENO is the go-to destination for events that bring people together. From company outings, birthday parties, team-building sessions and social gatherings, our venue combines competition, dining and entertainment in one place. With premier courts, signature food and beverage, and flexible event spaces, every detail is designed to make your event seamless and unforgettable.

  • 9 indoor & 6 outdoor pickleball courts
  • Center Court Bar & Kitchen
  • Outdoor beer garden & lawn games
  • Entertainment areas
  • Flex meeting spaces
